proposals.evidence: DEDR3085 explicitly gives Tamil/Malayalam tampi younger brother, with Kannada tamma and Telugu tammuḍu. These simple tampi/tambi survey responses continue the specific younger-brother kinship noun, retaining source intervocalic voicing and final vowels. The correct article is3085, not3485 (enclosure). This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

These simple and ordinary participial/nominal survey forms retain that drink stem and documented inflectional bases; source vowel/voicing and final morphology are preserved. Possible causative kuḍisu forms and opaque auxiliaries are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
